title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Ten named destinations along Farmingdale-area corridors, each paired with one practical, sourced reason to go.

cards.title: Settle In With a Book or Project
cards.subtitle: Merritts Road corridor — public library spaces and resources
cards.notes: Head to Merritts Road when you need public study space, books, digital resources, or a scheduled community program away from campus.
cards.short_summary: A public-library stop for focused reading, research resources, and community programming.
cards.evidence_claim: The Farmingdale Public Library is located at 116 Merritts Road and provides books, digital-library resources, programs, and meeting-room services.
cards.access_notes: Public operating hours and program schedules are posted on the library website; card eligibility may apply to borrowing and some services.

cards.title: Make the Block a Coffee Stop
cards.subtitle: Main Street corridor — coffee at 211 Main Street
cards.notes: Use the Main Street block for a coffee break at Flux, then continue on foot through Farmingdale’s mapped downtown business district.
cards.short_summary: A named downtown coffee destination on the village’s Main Street commercial corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Farmingdale Village lists Flux Coffee at 211 Main Street among its food establishments.
cards.access_notes: Check the business directly for current hours and service availability before traveling.

cards.title: Choose a Donut-and-Coffee Break
cards.subtitle: Main Street corridor — café stop at 314 Main Street
cards.notes: Walk the Main Street corridor to Vice when a donut-and-coffee stop fits the day; confirm the current menu and hours before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: A clearly identified café stop within Farmingdale’s downtown improvement district.
cards.evidence_claim: The Farmingdale Business Improvement District directory lists Vice Donuts And Coffee at 314 Main Street.
cards.source_title: Business Directory | Farmingdale Business Improvement District
cards.access_notes: Consult the business for current opening hours, menu availability, and ordering details.

cards.title: Get Fitted for the Next Run
cards.subtitle: Main Street corridor — running shop at 242 Main Street
cards.notes: Bring your current shoes to the Main Street block if you want to compare running gear or ask the specialty shop about fit and available models.
cards.short_summary: A named specialty-running retailer in the heart of Farmingdale’s Main Street district.
cards.evidence_claim: The Farmingdale Business Improvement District directory lists Runners Edge at 242 Main Street.
cards.source_title: Business Directory | Farmingdale Business Improvement District
cards.access_notes: Contact the shop for current hours, fitting availability, inventory, and service details.

cards.title: Browse the Thrift-Shop Racks
cards.subtitle: Main Street corridor — secondhand shopping at 301 Main Street
cards.notes: Add this Main Street storefront to a downtown walk when you want to browse secondhand goods; inventory and opening times can change.
cards.short_summary: A local thrift-shopping destination on Farmingdale’s central commercial street.
cards.evidence_claim: The Farmingdale Business Improvement District directory lists Farmingdale Thrift Shop at 301 Main Street.
cards.source_title: Business Directory | Farmingdale Business Improvement District
cards.access_notes: Verify current operating hours before visiting; merchandise availability varies.

cards.title: Browse a Small Downtown Shop
cards.subtitle: Main Street corridor — storefront at 216 Main Street
cards.notes: Pause at Nested Nook while walking Main Street and browse what is currently in the shop; call ahead if you need a particular item.
cards.short_summary: An independent storefront that adds a retail pause to a walk along Main Street.
cards.evidence_claim: The Farmingdale Business Improvement District directory lists Nested Nook at 216 Main Street.
cards.source_title: Business Directory | Farmingdale Business Improvement District
cards.access_notes: Check directly with the shop for current hours, accessibility details, and merchandise.

cards.title: Order Along the Fulton Street Strip
cards.subtitle: Fulton Street corridor — food stop at 559 Fulton Street
cards.notes: Use the Fulton Street corridor for a meal at Asian Pot, checking the restaurant’s current menu and service options before you set out.
cards.short_summary: A village-listed food destination on Fulton Street, southwest of the college.
cards.evidence_claim: Farmingdale Village lists Asian Pot at 559 Fulton Street among its food establishments.
cards.access_notes: Confirm current hours, menu, dietary information, and dine-in or takeout availability with the restaurant.

cards.title: See Historic Aircraft Up Close
cards.subtitle: New Highway corridor — aviation museum at Republic Airport
cards.notes: Follow New Highway to the museum for its aircraft collection and Republic Aviation setting; review admission details before visiting.
cards.short_summary: An aviation-history destination housed at Farmingdale’s Republic Airport complex.
cards.evidence_claim: The American Airpower Museum identifies its location as 1230 New Highway and publishes visiting hours for its aviation exhibits.
cards.access_notes: The museum posts Wednesday–Sunday visiting hours; verify the current schedule and admission terms before departure.

cards.title: Plan an Amusement-Park Outing
cards.subtitle: Broadhollow Road corridor — rides at 2245 Route 110
cards.notes: Travel south on the Route 110 corridor for rides and arcade attractions; check the operating calendar and ticket terms first.
cards.short_summary: A long-running amusement park directly on the Broadhollow Road commercial corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Nassau County Tourism lists Adventureland at 2245 Broadhollow Road and describes its thrill, family, kiddie, and water rides.
cards.access_notes: Seasonal operations apply; consult Adventureland for the current calendar, ride availability, age or height rules, and tickets.

cards.title: Take a Lap on an Indoor Track
cards.subtitle: Daniel Street corridor — electric karting at 40 Daniel Street
cards.notes: Turn onto Daniel Street for indoor electric karting, bowling, or arcade play; review racer requirements and reserve if needed.
cards.short_summary: An indoor recreation destination built around electric go-karts and additional games.
cards.evidence_claim: RPM Raceway’s official Long Island page gives the address as 40 Daniel Street and describes electric go-karts, bowling, VR, and arcade attractions.
cards.source_title: RPM Long Island, NY | Go-Kart Racing, Entertainment, Food & Drinks, Parties & Events
cards.access_notes: Check current hours, pricing, waivers, reservations, and driver height or age requirements on the official location page.
